name: 3D Interactive Hierarchy Editor
definition: A semantic control tool that allows users to define regions of interest by selecting primitive collections of voxels, which are then used to modify volume rendering parameters (color/opacity).
summary: The 3D Interactive Hierarchy Editor is a semantic control tool that modifies volume rendering by selecting 3D voxel primitives via a 2D slice interface, differing from local syntactic controls by using global set-membership.
